name: Callout
summary: A static note inside content: a tip, a caution or a fact to keep in mind, read in reading order with the text around it.
useWhen: A tip or a caution inside docs, help or a settings page
A fact a reader should not miss before a step, such as Deleting a team deletes its boards
Side guidance next to a form that is true whatever the person does
A short list of steps set apart from running text
avoidWhen: The message is about a problem that appeared after load and must be announced
The message is about the whole app
The person must act on it before going on
The note holds actions or a close button

tone.description: The color, the icon and the tone word: Note, Tip, Information, Success, Warning, Caution.

emphasis.description: soft is a tinted box, outline a tone border on the surface. Both keep the strong tone edge on the inline start side.

title.description: A short line that sums up the note. Optional: without it the tone word names the callout.

children.description: The note: text, paragraphs, a list, links or inline code.

icon.description: A system icon name or a node in place of the tone icon. The tone word stays on the icon part.

toneLabel.description: The word the icon says and the start of the callout's name. Default by tone and language.

as.description: div renders role note inside running content. aside renders a complementary landmark, for a note beside the main content; keep it outside other landmarks.

a11y.role: note (a div), or complementary (an aside). Named by the tone word on the icon and the title through aria-labelledby, for example Tip Move faster with the keyboard. An aria-label or aria-labelledby from the consumer wins.
a11y.focus: None. The callout takes no focus; links inside it are in the normal tab order.
a11y.announce: Never. No live role: it is read in reading order with the content around it. The icon is an image named with the tone word, so the tone is never told by color alone.
notes: No motion: a callout never moves, so it needs no reduced motion form.
No actions or close part: a note the person can dismiss or act on is an Alert.

en.title: A short line that sums up the note: Works offline. Sentence case, no exclamation marks.
en.body: One or two sentences, or a short list. Name the mechanism: Press the slash key to search.
en.danger: Say what is lost and how to avoid it: Deleting a team deletes its boards. Move them first.

ar.title: Noun forms where you can: العمل بدون اتصال. No diacritics. Western digits.
ar.lang: Under a Theme in Arabic the tone word switches to Arabic. Latin runs and code go through Bidi.

angular.note: The same DOM on Callout.css, ids from the CDK id generator.

native.note: A View with accessibilityRole text and the tone word at the start of its accessibilityLabel.

styles.studio: A tinted box with small corners and a 2px tone edge on the inline start side; achromatic accent.
styles.desk: The same box; the accent tone takes the yellow primary edge.
styles.liquid: Planned: a solid box, never glass, since a callout is content.

mistakes.wrong: A Callout for a sync error that appeared after load
mistakes.right: An Alert with live, so it is announced

mistakes.wrong: A Callout with a Retry button and a close button
mistakes.right: An Alert, which has actions and close

mistakes.wrong: Every paragraph of a page in a callout
mistakes.right: One callout per section at most; the rest is plain text

mistakes.wrong: as aside inside main content where it is not tangential
mistakes.right: The default div with role note
